title: Preserve unknown payload elements
description: Engineering consequence of HCERT Specification, 3.2.7 Health Certificate Claim.

statements.label: Preserve unknown payload elements
statements.requirement: Decoding a typed payload SHALL keep unknown elements and SHALL NOT fail because of them, so that newer template versions (v) can still be read and displayed.

sources.quote: Decoding applications SHOULD however be permissive and robust in these aspects
